projects.name: Smoking & Drinking Prediction Platform
projects.description: Independent data, analytics, and ML project that processed health-screening records, built reproducible workflows, trained classification models, and published dashboards and explanatory site.
projects.impact: Processed 991,346 health-screening records, retained 991,320 valid rows (invalid rate below 0.003%); trained models with 70.3% smoking prediction accuracy and 73.3% drinking prediction accuracy; published analytical tables, Looker Studio dashboards, and an Astro website for non-technical audiences.
projects.evidence_text: Validated large-scale data pipeline: Processed 991,346 health-screening records, retained 991,320 valid rows, and reduced invalid records to only 26, for an invalid rate below 0.003%. Modeling and automation: Built reproducible workflows with Python, SQL, BigQuery, Dataform, and Cloud Workflows; trained classification models that reached 70.3% smoking prediction accuracy and 73.3% drinking prediction accuracy. Stakeholder-facing delivery: Published analytical tables, Looker Studio dashboards, and an Astro website explaining the methodology, findings, and prediction demo for non-technical audiences.

projects.name: AI-Enabled Data Management Platform
projects.description: AI-enabled data and microservices platform that refactored a monolith into a multi-container service architecture, implemented CRUD and audit workflows, and integrated natural-language Q&A grounded on structured data.
projects.impact: Refactored monolithic API into a 7-container Docker platform with health checks and roughly 10 service endpoints; implemented audit logging and API contracts; integrated Gemini for natural-language Q&A and prepared semantic-search with pgvector while keeping answers traceable.
projects.evidence_text: Service architecture: Refactored a monolithic API into a 7-container Docker platform with a React frontend, 5 Node.js services, PostgreSQL, Nginx routing, health checks, and roughly 10 service endpoints. CRUD, audit, and traceability: Implemented people-management workflows, filtered reads, operation logs, SQL retrieval, and API contracts designed for integration and maintainability. AI grounded in structured data: Integrated Gemini for natural-language Q&A over structured records and prepared semantic-search support with pgvector while keeping answers traceable and grounded in database retrieval.

projects.name: ClimateWatch Colombia Project
projects.description: Serverless environmental data automation platform that schedules ingestion of weather and air-quality APIs and structures S3 storage into layered outputs for traceability and replay.
projects.impact: Designed layered storage and scalable configuration so new cities/variables/endpoints could be added without reworking architecture.
projects.evidence_text: Scheduled ingestion: Built serverless collectors triggered by EventBridge and AWS Lambda to consume external weather and air-quality APIs for Colombian cities. Layered storage design: Structured S3 storage into raw, curated, and audit layers with timestamped outputs to support traceability, replay, failure inspection, and future extension. Platform thinking: Designed the pipeline to scale by configuration so new cities, variables, or endpoints could be added without reworking the architecture.

projects.name: KyberVPN / Secure Chat Project
projects.description: Experimental secure communications backend and frontend implementing post-quantum key-exchange concepts, AES-GCM room-key handling, and encrypted messaging workflows.
projects.impact: Implemented 25 API routes across 2 routers for key management, encrypted chat, health/status, connection listing and disconnect flows; applied post-quantum key-exchange concepts and structured connection cleanup.
projects.evidence_text: Python/FastAPI backend: Developed a backend with 25 API routes across 2 routers plus root endpoints for key management, encrypted chat, health/status monitoring, connection listing, and disconnect flows. Applied cryptography: Implemented post-quantum key-exchange concepts with Kyber, room-key handling with AES-GCM, minimum encrypted-message validation, and structured connection cleanup. Client-side support: Also worked on the React client layer, including connection flows, encryption/decryption utilities, backend interoperability, and secure chat workflows.

projects.name: InCollege Academic project
projects.description: Console-based professional networking application implemented in COBOL with file persistence and automated testing.
projects.impact: Delivered menu-driven COBOL application supporting account creation, login, profiles, user search, connection requests, job posting/browsing, messaging, persistence via .DAT files, and automated scenario-based regression testing.
projects.evidence_text: End-to-end functional workflow: Worked on a menu-driven COBOL application supporting account creation, login, profiles, full-name user search, connection requests, established network views, job posting, job browsing, and basic messaging. Persistence and regression testing: The system uses ‘.DAT‘ files for persistence and includes automated scenario-based testing, fixture seeding by epic, and output verification for functional regression coverage.

experiences.title: Software Engineer – SGM Vehicle Workflow Platform
bullets: Built and maintained an internal operations platform for vehicle-registration and transit-service workflows using React, Electron, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, centralizing cases, payments, documents, shipments, statuses, services, and reporting.
Worked across 13 backend modules, 16 Prisma models, 97 route/controller decorators, and 26+ TypeScript/React views connected to JWT-secured REST APIs and desktop IPC authentication flows.
Turned manual workflows into auditable automation through PDF account statements, formula-safe CSV exports, reusable SQL reports, overdue/SLA detection, status history, and controlled file downloads.

Added bcrypt authentication, throttling, global validation, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, multipart upload docs, and test coverage to improve supportability, onboarding, and long-term maintainability.
experiences.evidence_text: Software Engineer – SGM Vehicle Workflow Platform Jan. 2025 – Jan. 2026. Production full-stack platform: Built and maintained an internal operations platform for vehicle-registration and transit-service workflows using React, Electron, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, centralizing cases, payments, documents, shipments, statuses, services, and reporting. Functional scale and architecture: Worked across 13 backend modules, 16 Prisma models, 97 route/controller decorators, and 26+ TypeScript/React views connected to JWT-secured REST APIs and desktop IPC authentication flows. Operational impact: Turned manual workflows into auditable automation through PDF account statements, formula-safe CSV exports, reusable SQL reports, overdue/SLA detection, status history, and controlled file downloads. Reliability and maintenance: Added bcrypt authentication, throttling, global validation, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, multipart upload docs, and test coverage to improve supportability, onboarding, and long-term maintainability.
